notes.title: Interactive Teaser!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear friends!

Interactive teaser of our new game is now available! You can download it on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608620/]"Sex, Please" page[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44660359/76bbfe42839deee941c677c1f5b9f255eb5736f4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear friends![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/6bbb1eba66f85aaf690b58c29f6147d5326d907b.png[/img]

[b]The release of our short visual novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499420/Broken_Hearts_Island/]"Broken Hearts Island"[/url] has taken place![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/ef9c852701b200fb35667d2a2bff6519c52772e3.png[/img]

[i]If you like this game, please like it and [b]be active![/b][/i]

[b]With a successful start we will be able to add [u][b]collectible cards[/b][/u] to the game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/bcf3eabb3cfa2d4507e5b5ac9b3f6ffb2c5e5660.png[/img]

[i]Also, I'm already working on the continuation of the story =)[/i][/h2]
